report_dirs.name: Chrome Gemini on-device model
report_dirs.note: Gemini Nano model used by Chrome's on-device AI features, often around 4 GB. If you don't use them, turn on-device AI off in Chrome's settings; deleting the folder alone just makes Chrome download it again.

report_dirs.name: Chrome ServiceWorker CacheStorage
report_dirs.note: Offline caches of websites and PWAs. Clear cached files from Chrome's 'Delete browsing data' dialog instead of deleting the folder; keep Cookies and IndexedDB.

report_dirs.name: Chrome extensions
report_dirs.note: Remove extensions from chrome://extensions, not by deleting folders.

report_dirs.name: Claude Desktop VM bundles
report_dirs.note: Local VM used by Claude Desktop's Cowork feature, can be around 10 GB. Quit Claude Desktop first and remove it only if you understand how Cowork sessions and their data are affected.

report_dirs.name: Xcode DerivedData
report_dirs.note: Build output only. Safe to delete while Xcode is closed.

report_dirs.name: Xcode CoreSimulator
report_dirs.note: Simulator devices and data. 'xcrun simctl delete unavailable' removes devices for runtimes you no longer have; remove runtimes in Xcode > Settings > Components.

report_dirs.name: SwiftPM cache
report_dirs.note: Downloaded Swift packages. Re-downloaded on the next build if removed.

report_dirs.name: Playwright browsers
report_dirs.note: Browsers downloaded by Playwright. 'npx playwright uninstall --all' removes them; projects download them again when needed.

report_dirs.name: Cargo registry
report_dirs.note: Downloaded crate sources. Safe to delete; crates are re-downloaded on the next build.

report_dirs.name: rustup toolchains
report_dirs.note: Installed Rust toolchains. List with 'rustup toolchain list' and remove unused ones with 'rustup toolchain uninstall <name>'.

report_dirs.name: Hugging Face models
report_dirs.note: Downloaded models. Use 'huggingface-cli delete-cache' to pick which ones to remove.

report_dirs.name: Ollama models
report_dirs.note: List models with 'ollama list' and remove with 'ollama rm <model>'.

report_dirs.name: LM Studio models
report_dirs.note: Delete models from LM Studio's model list inside the app.

report_dirs.name: VS Code update cache
report_dirs.note: Downloaded update packages. Safe to delete after quitting VS Code.

report_dirs.name: GitHub Desktop update cache
report_dirs.note: Downloaded update packages. Safe to delete after quitting GitHub Desktop.

report_dirs.name: Atomic Chat llama.cpp models
report_dirs.note: Local GGUF models. Remove unused models from inside the app, not the whole data folder.

report_dirs.name: ego lite extensions
report_dirs.note: Old extension versions can pile up here. Keep current versions, Secure Preferences, Local Extension Settings, and any wallet extension data.

report_dirs.name: Google AI Edge models
report_dirs.note: On-device models. Check whether you still need them before removing anything.
